title: run.yipyap.reply.alert.route.v1
description: Create a scoped, time-limited routing rule that redirects future matching alerts to a specified channel. High blast radius, requires per-channel trust flag and mandatory expiry.

target_channel_id.description: Notification channel ID to route matching alerts to. Must exist in this org.

match_filter.description: Fields describing which alerts the rule covers. Must include at least one of: monitor_id (string), severity (string), type_glob (string). Empty match_filter rejected.

expires_at.description: When this routing rule stops applying. Mandatory and bounded at channel level (default max 24h from now). Rejects if in the past or beyond the cap.

reason.description: Justification stored on the audit log and rendered on the rule in the admin UI.
